name: CheckInFile
description: Checks in a file to a SharePoint document library using Microsoft Graph, optionally creating a minor or major version.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the SharePoint request.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint URL of the file you want to check in. For example: /sites/YourSite/Shared Documents/YourFile.txt

fields.name: CheckInType
fields.label: Check-In Type
fields.description: Select the type of check-in operation to perform. 'Minor' creates a minor version, 'Major' creates a major version, and 'Simple' checks in without creating a new version.

selectOptions.label: Simple
selectOptions.description: Checks in without creating a new version.

fields.name: Comment
fields.label: Check-In Comment
fields.description: An optional comment to include with the check-in operation, providing context or notes about the changes made.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the file check-in operation, including success status and any error messages.
